about.title: About me
about.description: Senior Software Engineer based in Kagawa, Japan, specializing in .NET backend systems, AWS and distributed data workflows. I work across requirements, architecture, implementation and production support. My applied AI experience includes commercial feasibility work and personal products.
highlights: English, Polish, Ukrainian, Russian and Japanese N4

items.highlight: Client-facing solution engineering with Forward Deployed Engineer responsibilities. Built and extended a Python / Qt finance tool with estimated savings of 1-2 person-days per month; designed a custom Django ERP with centralized pricing and authenticated MCP endpoints, and a read-only legacy ERP integration. ERP and modernization projects remain under active development.

Built a greenfield POS administration application and reduced selected analytical update latency from approximately 1-2 minutes to 10-20 seconds. Implemented approximately 300 MB streaming CSV exports, Cognito session handling and RabbitMQ integration. Contributed to an estimated recurring AWS cost reduction of about USD 1,300 per month versus the original infrastructure estimate; also delivered business automation and legacy modernization.

items.company: Honki Mode - feasibility prototype within the same role
items.highlight: Designed and implemented a React, .NET Lambda and Amazon Bedrock RAG prototype with tool calling. Identified a model-controlled identity trust-boundary flaw and helped evaluate the decision not to productionize the system because retrieval, security and cost-to-impact were unfavorable.
Developed APIs and microservices for a UK university-admission platform and created reusable dynamic model-mapping and OpenAPI tooling that reduced duplicated backend/frontend contracts.

Maintained a mission-critical public-safety Windows application used across more than 40 U.S. counties, covering complex legacy debugging, performance, refactoring and L2/L3 production support in a 3,000+ test environment.
Delivered ASP.NET Core and Angular functionality for a penetration-testing management platform, contributing to architecture and refactoring discussions.
Built game-backend and administration functionality, REST APIs and lightweight request validation using Redis and MongoDB.
Customized Moody's CreditLens for banking clients and improved selected reporting workflows by approximately 30-40% through SQL redesign, caching and parallel retrieval.
